patch_list: Skip reward videos and receive the normal in-app reward. Existing reward amounts and daily limits stay unchanged.
PikieWalker: Skip Google Play install check
Let the patched app open without asking you to install it from Google Play. This patch is required and included automatically. Technical reference: Pairip client-side license check.
